ns2:course.label: Introduction to Programming
ns2:course.description: Introduction to computer programming with non-technical focus. Elementary principles of object-oriented programming. Problem solving in various domains. Areas of application include graphics and multimedia, game design, programming in a 3D environment, computer art and poetry. Basic concepts and skills covered include data types and data representation, arithmetic, logical, and string operations, conditional execution, iteration recursion, modular programming, functions, procedures, libraries and code re-use. Language used and problem domain area may vary by semester.
